about.heroSubtitle: Our journey, our inspiration, and our commitment to humanity.
about.journeyTitle: Rooted in Marathwada, Driven by Humanity.
about.story1: Founded on 18 July 2001 in Ambajogai, Beed, Aadhar Manuskicha began with a simple yet profound belief: that every life deserves a strong foundation of dignity and support.
about.story2: Our organization was born out of a deep understanding of the unique challenges faced by the people of the Marathwada region—from recurring droughts and agrarian crises to limited access to quality education and healthcare.
about.story3: Over the past 23+ years, we have grown from a small group of passionate volunteers into a registered charitable trust that actively impacts thousands of lives across 25+ villages.

values.title: Vision
values.desc: A society where every individual, regardless of background, has access to education, healthcare, and a dignified life.

values.title: Mission
values.desc: To empower marginalized communities of Marathwada through sustainable grassroots interventions in education, health, and livelihoods.

values.title: Transparency
values.desc: We maintain 100% financial and operational transparency, ensuring every rupee directly reaches beneficiaries.

values.title: Sustainability
values.desc: Our interventions focus on self-reliance rather than temporary relief or dependency.

about.gadgebabaText: Sant Gadgebaba Sevabhavi Sanstha operates under the profound inspiration of Sant Gadgebaba, a mendicant-saint and social reformer from Maharashtra. He traveled village to village, sweeping streets and preaching cleanliness, eradication of blind faith, and the supreme importance of education.
about.founderP1: An advocate by profession and a social worker by calling, Adv. Santosh Pawar established Aadhar Manuskicha with a vision to provide legal, educational, and social aid to the voiceless.
about.founderP2: Under his leadership, the organization has prioritized immediate action and transparent operations, building deep trust within the Ambajogai community over the last two decades.
about.registeredOfficeValue: At. Shivajinagar, Bank Colony, Jogaiwadi, Ambajogai, Beed – 431517, Maharashtra

focus.heroSubtitle: Comprehensive, grassroots interventions designed for holistic development in Marathwada.
focus.ctaText: You can support our work broadly, or direct your donation to a specific focus area.

areas.title: Education & Literacy
areas.desc: We believe education is the primary tool to break the cycle of poverty.
items: Annual full scholarships for meritorious students
Distribution of books, uniforms, and stationery kits
Dropout prevention counseling for at-risk families
Career guidance and mentorship programs

areas.title: Rural Development
areas.desc: Addressing the core economic engine of Marathwada by supporting farmers.
items: Farmer welfare advocacy during agrarian crises
Facilitating access to government agriculture schemes
Awareness on sustainable and water-efficient farming
Village infrastructure and sanitation initiatives

areas.title: Health & Wellness
areas.desc: Bringing quality healthcare to remote villages, focusing on preventive care.
items: Regular free general and specialized eye camps
Free medicine distribution for common ailments
Blood donation drives with local hospitals
Health and hygiene awareness programs in ZP schools

areas.title: Women Empowerment
areas.desc: Fostering financial independence and legal awareness among rural women.
items: Formation of Bachat Gats (Self-Help Groups)
Vocational training (tailoring, beauty parlor, handicrafts)
Legal literacy regarding women's rights and property laws
Domestic violence prevention and social advocacy

areas.title: Youth & Skill Dev
areas.desc: Equipping the youth with modern skills for employment and entrepreneurship.
items: Basic computer literacy and digital awareness
MPSC / competitive exam guidance and materials
Helpdesk for government employment schemes
Entrepreneurship mentoring for rural youth

areas.title: Disaster Relief & Aid
areas.desc: Acting as first responders during natural or man-made crises.
items: Emergency food kit distribution during floods/droughts
COVID-19 era support (rations, medical facilitation)
Winter blanket distribution for destitute and homeless
Local volunteer network for rapid response
